rv.q: Ultimately, though, they have done this little, hopeful show no favors by dragging it into a spotlight that invites close and unforgiving inspection.
The producers have done an extreme disservice to the inexperienced creative team by shoving them into the spotlight with what’s likely to be a commercial embarrassment.
Practically everything else is a writhing mass of convoluted pandering.

cn.t: Critics dismiss this coming-of-age musical as callow and immature, criticizing its lack of substance and self-indulgent navel-gazing that fails to justify its Broadway berth.

vs.sum: Broadway's only thrust-stage theater offers an unmatched intimate experience — no seat is more than a few rows from the action. Sightlines are excellent from every angle, though some seats face actors' backs during certain scenes.

acc.note: Elevator accessible through adjoining building. Loop technology and neck induction systems available.
